strategy.thesis: Taipei single-family office managing the wealth of the Tsai (Fubon Group founder) family. Invests globally across private equity and venture capital — direct seed through later-stage rounds and via PE/VC funds — with thematic interests in Life Science, Technology and Sustainability; participates in co-investments alongside major institutional funds.

summary.en: WTT Investment is a Taipei-based single-family office that manages the wealth of the Tsai family, descended from late Fubon Group founder Tsai Wan-Tsai. It invests globally across private equity and venture capital (direct seed through Series F, plus PE/VC fund commitments) with a thematic focus on life sciences, technology and sustainability, and co-invests with leading institutional funds. Disclosed venture deals include biotech rounds such as Allay Therapeutics' US$60M Series C and Remix Therapeutics' Series C.

aka: Koo family (CTBC / KGI / Chailease / Taiwan Cement)

strategy.thesis: Family office of Taiwan's Koo dynasty (controlling shareholders of CTBC Financial Holding, KGI Financial, Taiwan Cement and Chailease). Channels family capital into venture / private-equity allocations — most visibly AI-infrastructure equity (via Era Funds) and private credit (via a Chailease-managed fund) — anchoring funds targeting AI/Nvidia-ecosystem companies. Next-generation venture vehicle K8 Capital (New York) invests in AI and enterprise-software startups.

people.name: Andre Koo Sr.
people.role: Principal / Koo family (anchored AI funds via family office)

people.name: Andre Koo Jr.
people.role: Next-generation member; founder of K8 Capital

summary.en: The Koo Family Office manages the fortune of Taiwan's Koo dynasty — controlling shareholders of CTBC Financial Holding, KGI Financial, Taiwan Cement and Chailease — with a combined family wealth estimated at about US$7 billion. In November 2025, Andre Koo Sr. committed at least US$100M through the family office to anchor two new AI funds: US$50M into Era Funds (equity stakes in AI-infrastructure companies, e.g. Nvidia-ecosystem firms) and US$50M into a Chailease-managed private-credit fund, part of a US$1.5B AI raise. The next generation runs K8 Capital, a New York hybrid VC / private-credit firm targeting AI and enterprise-software startups.
summary.local: 辜家家族辦公室管理台灣辜氏家族的財富——辜家為中信金控（CTBC）、凱基金控（KGI）、台泥與中租（Chailease）的控股股東，家族財富合計約 70 億美元。2025 年 11 月，辜仲（Andre Koo Sr.）透過家族辦公室出資至少 1 億美元，作為兩檔新 AI 基金的基石資金：5,000 萬美元投入 Era Funds（投資 AI 基礎建設公司股權，如 Nvidia 生態系），5,000 萬美元投入中租管理的私募信貸基金，屬於一檔 15 億美元 AI 募資的一部分。新世代成員經營位於紐約的 K8 Capital，為 AI 與企業軟體新創的創投／私募信貸混合公司。

strategy.thesis: Taipei-based multi-family office (founded 2003) serving overseas Chinese families, with allocations across private equity, venture capital, real estate and funds-of-funds; sector interests include financial services / fintech and consumer / e-commerce.

summary.en: Hwa Family Office is a Taipei-based multi-family office founded in 2003, primarily serving overseas Chinese families with wealth-preservation, legacy-education and trust solutions. Its investment approach spans private equity, venture capital, real estate and funds-of-funds across Asia, North America and globally, with sector interest in financial services / fintech and consumer / e-commerce (e.g. an investment in French e-commerce company Monogram).
